EVT-AP-050-LOCK-SPLIT-PHASE.rationale: Lock ownership is session-bound in Postgres; split-phase locking provides no safety under concurrency and can cause double-writes.
EVT-AP-050-LOCK-SPLIT-PHASE.rule: Taking an advisory lock on one DB connection/session and performing the protected write on a different connection/session (lock-on-conn-A / write-on-conn-B).

EVT-AP-051-SESSION-SCOPED-LOCKS-FOR-STAT.rationale: Transaction-scoped locks auto-release at commit/rollback and reduce orphan/lease drift risk; aligns with LOCKS-1@2.1.0.
EVT-AP-051-SESSION-SCOPED-LOCKS-FOR-STAT.rule: Using session-scoped advisory locks (pg_advisory_lock / pg_try_advisory_lock) for state transitions instead of transaction-scoped locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock / pg_try_advisory_xact_lock) where applicable.

EVT-AP-IAM-REBUILD.rule: Do not duplicate IAM authorization model inside EVT-2; depend on IAM-1 for enforcement

EVT-AP-NO-UNAUDITED-MUTATION.rule: No mutation of published content without immutable revision + audit entry

EVT-AP-PRICING-IN-EVT.rule: No money fields in EVT-2 (no cents/currency/base_price/fee) — reference PRICE-1

EVT-AP-SEATS-IN-EVT.rule: No seatmaps/holds/inventory truth in EVT-2 — reference SEAT-1/SEAT-2

publish_event.purpose: Publish a draft Event through a governed organizer action.
validation_rules: Event MUST exist within org_id, status MUST be draft, and published_at_utc MUST be null.
Actor MUST be authorized to publish this event in org_id.
Atomically set status=published, set published_at_utc=database_now, increment Event.version, and enqueue the registered EVT-1 ticketing.event.published.v1 outbox record using the committed version.

Event payload MUST contain exactly the registered required data keys event_id and version plus required envelope extensions org_id, trace_id, and request_id; published_at_utc remains durable Event state and is not an unregistered payload key.
The publication transition, timestamp, version, and outbox record MUST commit or roll back together.

state_transition.side_effects: Atomically set status=published, published_at_utc=database_now, increment version, and enqueue ticketing.event.published.v1.

open_occurrence_sales.purpose: Open occurrence sales through an explicit governed action.
validation_rules: Occurrence MUST be scheduled and belong to event_id and org_id.
Parent Event MUST be published in org_id.
sales_open_at_utc and sales_close_at_utc MUST both be present and sales_open_at_utc < sales_close_at_utc.
Database now MUST be >= sales_open_at_utc and < sales_close_at_utc.
Actor MUST be authorized to manage sales for org_id.
Buyer eligibility MUST independently evaluate database UTC against both configured timestamps and fail closed even if stored status lags.

close_occurrence_sales.purpose: Close occurrence sales through an explicit governed action.
validation_rules: Occurrence MUST be sales_open and belong to event_id and org_id.
Actor MUST be authorized to manage sales for org_id; a system/service actor MAY close at or after sales_close_at_utc.
Sales close action MUST preserve event cancellation, postponement and rescheduling sovereignty.
Buyer eligibility MUST fail closed when database UTC is at or after sales_close_at_utc even if stored status remains sales_open.

experiments.default: experiments must not mutate purchase_eligibility unless explicitly enabled per experiment
experiments.rationale: Prevents experiment variants from weakening entitlement gates or creating inconsistent upsell promises.

offer_teasers.eligibility_rule: If purchase_eligibility.requires_entitlement=true, then purchase_eligibility must include entitlement_program_id and either allowed_sub_tier_ids (preferred) or allow_any_tier=true.
offer_teasers.ref_rule: price_item_ref_type + price_item_ref_id must reference PRICE-1 PriceLine item_ref_type/item_ref_id for the current pricing program revision
offer_teasers.visibility_rule: Public visibility is allowed even when purchase is locked; UI must mark as locked and ORD-1 must re-check at finalize.

locks_session_affinity_required.rationale: All advisory locks that guard writes MUST be acquired and used within the same Repo.transaction / DB backend session as the protected mutation. This aligns EVT-2 actions with LOCKS-1@2.1.0 session-affinity hardening.

require_sm0_fencing_for_stateful_mutatio.rationale: All stateful mutations executed by workers or asynchronous flows MUST use SM-0 style fencing/optimistic-lock predicates (Compare-And-Swap on lock_version/state) so a stale worker cannot overwrite newer state.

occurrences.admission_scope: Admission truth is occurrence-scoped. SCAN-1 and TKT-1 MUST key admission decisions to occurrence_id.
occurrences.check_in_window_bounds: check_in_open_at_utc MUST be <= check_in_close_at_utc. Both MUST (as policy-defined) be within [starts_at_utc - policy, ends_at_utc + policy] as defined by org policy.
occurrences.check_in_window_required: check_in_open_at_utc and check_in_close_at_utc MUST be present for every occurrence.
occurrences.denormalized_reality_recommendation: To avoid hot-path joins, child occurrences SHOULD persist cached_parent_status updated during parent->child cascade. If cached_parent_status is present and differs from the actual parent.status, the child MUST be treated as failed (fail-closed).
occurrences.hierarchy_depth_law: depth_level MUST be 0 for root. If parent_occurrence_id is present then depth_level MUST be 1. parent_occurrence_id MUST NOT reference an occurrence with depth_level=1.
occurrences.reentry_policy_rules: If reentry_policy=scan_out_required then check_out_open_at_utc and check_out_close_at_utc MUST be present and check_out_open_at_utc <= check_out_close_at_utc.
occurrences.scan_policy_required: scan_preferred_authority, scan_max_offline_age_seconds, scan_duplicate_grace_seconds, scan_stale_behavior MUST be present for every occurrence.
occurrences.sovereignty_verification_law: Any projection or API response that includes a child occurrence with parent_occurrence_id MUST include parent_sovereignty_verified_at_utc, representing the time at which parent sovereignty was checked.
occurrences.stale_reality_seal: Child occurrences MAY persist parent_state_fingerprint to detect stale cached_parent_status. If parent_state_fingerprint is present and does not match the current parent state fingerprint, the child MUST be treated as failed (fail-closed) until reconciled.
occurrences.state_entailment_law: If depth_level=1 and status is sales_open then parent.status MUST NOT be in {cancel_pending,cancelled,completed}. Consumers MUST check parent status on read paths.

parent_state_fingerprint.notes: Parent status_changed timestamp is the canonical transition time used to invalidate stale caches.

rules.text: Zombie session prevention: a child occurrence is invalid-by-definition for selling/active read paths if its parent is terminal non-active. Orchestration may cascade statuses asynchronously, but correctness MUST be enforced synchronously on read and write paths.
Hierarchy depth is limited to one level (root + child). depth_level enables O(1) checks. No recursive lookup is required to enforce the limit.
org_id is a partition constraint. Database-level RLS MUST prevent a child occurrence from linking to or reading a parent occurrence belonging to a different org_id.

Read-time sovereignty: If a child occurrence has status in {:active,:selling,:sales_open} but its parent occurrence status is in {:cancel_pending,:cancelled,:archived,:failed,:completed}, the child MUST be treated as invalid (Ghost Reality) and MUST NOT be presented as sellable or scannable. If cached_parent_status and/or parent_state_fingerprint are stale, the system MUST fail-closed.

rules.statement: EVT-2.Occurrence completion (status -> :completed) is BLOCKED if any SCAN-1.Scan record for the same {org_id, occurrence_id} remains provisional=true and unresolved. The transition MUST fail closed with ERR_UNRESOLVED_PROVISIONAL_SCANS until a valid SCAN-1 ResolutionManifest attestation resolves all provisional scans to a terminal status.

rules.text: Event publication and occurrence sales opening/closing MUST occur only through publish_event, open_occurrence_sales and close_occurrence_sales. Opening requires a published parent Event and a valid configured UTC sale window. Buyer eligibility checks UTC time fail-closed even when stored status lags. These actions do not add a timer or worker and do not change cancellation, postponement or rescheduling sovereignty.

Event.status=draft MUST imply published_at_utc=null. Event.status=published MUST imply published_at_utc is non-null and sourced from the database clock. publish_event MUST atomically persist status, published_at_utc, incremented version, and the registered event outbox record. Archival MUST preserve the historical published_at_utc.

summary: Event publication domain: events (identity, visibility, SEO), occurrences (timezone-aware scheduling), revisioned page content, redirect history, experiments governance, and auditability. Delegates pricing to PRICE-1, ordering to ORD-1, seating/inventory truth to SEAT-1 (+ SEAT-2 maps), tracking attribution to TRK-1 (consent-gated), and notifications to COMM-1 (future).
